ELECTRICITY — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.

2. When learning Inspection and Testing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Inspection and Testing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inspection and Testing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Inspection and Testing.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning Power Supplies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Power Supplies.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Supplies.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Supplies.

5. When learning Earthing and Excess Current Protection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

6. When learning Electronics 4.4 Project Identification, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

8. When learning DC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for DC Generators.
   C. Skip safety briefings for DC Generators.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after DC Generators.

9. When learning Single Phase AC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Generators.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Generators.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Generators.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Generators.

10. When learning Measuring Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring Instruments.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Measuring Instruments.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring Instruments.

11. When learning Wiring Systems and Regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Wiring Systems and Regulations.

12. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

13. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

14. When learning Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

16. When learning Electrical Diagrams, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Single Phase AC Generators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Wiring Systems and Regulations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
